layers.name: ByteEmbedding
layers.doc: Fixed 256-row trainable embedding for packed U8 or U32 byte IDs.
layers.adaptation: Complete existing Rust composition over canonical Embedding and Linear; preserves fixed 256-byte vocabulary, child-owned parameter identities, U8/U32 gather adjoints and FP32 affine adjoints; retains Rust deterministic seeded initialization rather than donor constructor distributions

layers.name: ByteHead
layers.doc: Trainable affine output head from hidden rows to 256 byte logits.
layers.adaptation: Complete existing Rust composition over canonical Embedding and Linear; preserves fixed 256-byte vocabulary, child-owned parameter identities, U8/U32 gather adjoints and FP32 affine adjoints; retains Rust deterministic seeded initialization rather than donor constructor distributions
